title: chore(objectui): move the console pin from 0707b4ae3712 to 4016370af3c9, the newest green objectui main and the first pin past objectui#12957
body:
Fixes #24457
Clause-②: no

This PR moves the console pin from `0707b4ae3712` to `4016370af3c9`. That is objectui `main` at `4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8` (objectui PR #13018), the newest objectui `main` commit that was green at the move. It is the first pin that carries objectui `749ed760` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12957's merge), so it is the first console build that takes `scripts/build-console.sh`'s `.objectstack-sha` branch (#24306, PR #24440). The maintainer's order, verbatim: 「你继续负责验证。.objectui-sha 可以升级到最新」. This PR is the end-to-end verification of ruling B on objectstack-ai/objectui#12955, so its evidence below is the deliverable.

This PR is not a release act. The Version Packages PR is not touched, and no release workflow is dispatched.

**Tier:** not governed. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the five paths: "0 of 5 path(s) hit the register ... NOT governed". Size: 5 files, +80 / -10.

## Choosing the pin

- **Green, read at the move.** REST `repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/commits/SHA/check-runs`, every page, read by this session:

  | objectui `main` commit | check-runs | verdict |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | **`4016370af3c9`** (tip; read 2026-10-19T05:06:51Z) | **104 completed: 101 success, 3 skipped, 0 failure** | **newest green: the target** |
  | `46dbf32bf57f` | 69 completed: 64 success, 3 skipped, 2 cancelled (`Repo Gates`, `Bundle Analysis`) | not green: two checks never reached a verdict |
  | `09eadf4e1c14` | 99 completed: 96 success, 3 skipped | green (the card's filing-time tip) |
  | `d0934b919d64` | 101 completed: 97 success, 1 failure (`Snapshot the board to the archive branch`), 3 skipped | not green |

  At 04:48Z the tip still had 20 runs in progress. The session waited in the foreground until the last one (`Test (coverage)`) completed at 05:06:51Z, read `git ls-remote` (still `4016370af3c9`), and bumped at 05:06:59Z.
- **The bump.** `OBJECTUI_ROOT=SCRATCH_CLONE bash scripts/bump-objectui.sh --no-commit 4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8`, exit 0: "objectui pin: 0707b4ae3712 → 4016370af3c9 (on origin/main)". The range walked completely in a full (non-shallow) scratch clone. ⛔ The shared `../objectui` checkout was never written: every objectui read and every build tree came from a scratch clone named by `OBJECTUI_ROOT`.
- **Ancestry,** in that clone (`--is-shallow-repository` false):
  - `git merge-base --is-ancestor 749ed7607614 4016370af3c9…`: exit 0. objectui#12957's merge is in the pin; an exit 0 proves itself in any checkout.
  - the old pin `0707b4ae3712` is an ancestor: exit 0.
  - control, the reverse (`4016370af3c9` an ancestor of `749ed760`): exit 1.
  - range `0707b4ae3712..4016370af3c9`: 33 non-merge commits.
- **objectui's own objectstack pin** at `4016370af3c9`: `.objectstack-sha` = `2c9bf9430a1198bfaa5c0de9ff4a811838c6869c`, unchanged since `749ed760`.

## The dispatch's mechanism assumptions, measured

All four are measured at this PR's head `4289f447b1`: the branch merged with `origin/main` `ec951e29e4`, which carries #24427 (`26501ae24f`) and the spec retirement #24442 (`69f342b924`, `feat(spec)!`).

1. **The new branch runs, in the expected order.** From the `build-console.sh` log at `4289f447b1`, in order:
   - `→ objectui@4016370af3c9 installs @objectstack/client @objectstack/core @objectstack/formula @objectstack/lint @objectstack/sdui-parser @objectstack/spec @objectstack/types by commit — building them here...`, then the closure build (turbo, with declarations): 36/36 tasks;
   - `→ OBJECTSTACK_ROOT is set: packing @objectstack/* from /home/user/objectstack-issue-24457, standing in for the pin 2c9bf9430a11.`, `pack 7 package(s): 15.8s`, and `✓ node_modules/.cache/objectstack now holds ... from /home/user/objectstack-issue-24457 (4289f447b122)`;
   - the frozen install: `Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped`, `Done in 6.5s`;
   - objectui's `@object-ui/console^...` build: 34/34 tasks, 0 cached. 12 of those packages build with `tsc` first, and the console's own build is `tsc && vite build`, so objectui's sources type-check against this tree's packed declarations. Then the console bundle: `✓ 8956 modules transformed.`
2. **The dependency-name check passes.** objectui did not move its own pin (`.objectstack-sha` is still `2c9bf9430a`, as the PM measured). Re-measured anyway: the `dependencies`, `optionalDependencies` and `peerDependencies` NAMES of all seven packages are identical between objectstack `2c9bf9430a` and this tree (versions moved `18.0.0-next.3` → `18.0.0-next.4` with the Version Packages merge `725a5b1311`; names did not). The pin script's own lockfile check passed: it refuses on a difference, and it exited 0 before the install.
3. **Everything installed is this tree's.** Read off the build tree after the install, at `4289f447b1`:
   - `node_modules/.cache/objectstack/.stamp.json`: `source: external`, `root` = this worktree, `sha` = `4289f447b122…`, `dirty: false`.
   - `node_modules/.pnpm`: 7 `@objectstack` entries, all 7 in the `@objectstack+NAME@file+node_modules+.cache+objectstack+NAME…` form.
   - each installed package's `dist/` against `packages/NAME/dist/`: `diff -rq` exit 0 for all seven (spec, core, types, client, formula, sdui-parser, lint). Control: the installed spec's `dist` against `packages/core/dist`: exit 1.
   - the build tree's `pnpm-lock.yaml` (byte-identical to the one committed at `4016370af3c9`, `cmp` exit 0): 0 registry-resolved `@objectstack/*` keys, 14 `file:` keys. Control for the pattern: the same grep over objectui's lockfile at the old pin `0707b4ae3712` counts 14 registry-resolved keys (`'@objectstack/client@18.0.0-next.3'` and the rest).
4. **The usual move gates pass.** All in the tables below. Nothing turned red, so no contract difference between this tree (including #24442's retirement) and the new objectui pin was found.

## Console Pin Gate, local equivalent

Run step by step as `ci.yml`'s `console-pin` job runs it. Each exit code was captured before any pipe; heavy steps ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Shared 4-core box, so wall-clock figures are shared-box readings. Deviations from the CI job: `--concurrency=2` instead of 4 (the container's resource rule), and `OBJECTUI_ROOT` names a full scratch clone where CI shallow-clones (with no `OBJECTUI_ROOT`, this checkout's sibling `../objectui`, a shared checkout, would have been used).

**Run 3, at this PR's head `4289f447b1`.** The build tree and the dist were deleted first, so the objectui worktree, the install and both builds were fresh.

| step | command | exit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| install | `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` | 0 |
| closure | `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client... --concurrency=2` (36/36; lock VERDICT `command-exit 0`) | 0 |
| build | `OBJECTUI_ROOT=SCRATCH_CLONE bash scripts/build-console.sh` (lock VERDICT `command-exit 0`, held 481 s) | 0 |
| assert | the job's "Assert a real Console dist is in place" script, verbatim, `CACHE_HIT` empty: `✓ Console dist present (65352 KB, via scripts/build-console.sh) from objectui@4016370af3c9` | 0 |
| stamp | `pnpm check:console-sha`: `✓ Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@4016370af3c9).` | 0 |
| injection | `pnpm check:console-injection --require-stamp` (self-test 67 assertions; the stamp records no observable skew) | 0 |
| manifest | `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`: 107 components, sha256 `c6b03966dae9…`; byte-identical to the committed pair (`git status --porcelain`: 0 lines) | 0 |

Inside the build: `✓ Bundle canary 'import/jobs' present`; `✓ Single-zod canary: exactly one zod version literal {major:4,minor:6,patch:7}` (2258 `assets/*.js` read); `✓ Injected and vendored @objectstack/spec declare the same descriptions — no observable skew` (the vendored spec IS this tree's packed spec now); `✓ Shipped the tracked sdui.manifest.json (recorded at objectui@4016370af3c9, this pin)`; `✓ @objectstack/console dist ready (65352 KB) from objectui@4016370af3c9`.

**The bundled spec is this tree's, two ways:**
- Two-sided, on a copy of the dist, against the npm `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.3` tarball (the spec objectui's own pin was released as): `node scripts/assert-console-spec-injection.mjs --injected packages/spec --vendored NPM_NEXT3 --objectui BUILD_TREE --assets COPY/assets`, exit 0: "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it", 16 of 16 injected-only descriptions present, the 1 published-only description absent.
- Witnesses from the merged-in commits themselves, each in the bundle (1 asset each), each absent from the npm next.3 spec (0):
  - #24442 (`69f342b924`): the page action row's rewritten describes ("The row runs the declared action its ...", "the route writes them only where the acti..."); 0 in `packages/spec/src` at `26501ae24f`, the commit before it.
  - #24427 (`26501ae24f`): the navigation item's `visible` describe (`BaseNavItemSchema`, "no console renders ..."); 0 in `packages/spec/src` at the base `725a5b1311`.
  So the console bundles this tree as of the PR head, not an earlier build.

**Two earlier runs of the same sequence**, each all exit 0, with the same item 1 to 3 readings (seven `diff -rq` exit 0, control exit 1, 0 registry-resolved keys) and the same two-sided probe (16/16 present, 1/1 absent):
- Run 2 at `b0899060c5` (merged with `26501ae24f`), fresh tree: `build-console.sh` held the lock 478 s, `dist ready (65336 KB)`; the generator's re-run there was byte-identical too.
- Run 1 at `4dd6c40d4d` (before any merge; base `725a5b1311`): `build-console.sh` held 472 s, `pack 7 package(s): 18.3s`, frozen install `Done in 8.4s`, `dist ready (65332 KB)`; this run produced the committed manifest pair.

## The second half: manifest and lockstep record

- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, exit 0: 107 components, sha256 `c6b03966dae9…`, re-recorded `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` at the pin (`built-tree`, `@object-ui/core` 17.7.0). Re-run at `b0899060c5` and at `4289f447b1`: exit 0 and byte-identical both times.
- `sdui.manifest.json` changes in two components, no component added or removed (107 → 107):
  - `record:related_list`'s `relationshipValueField` description no longer names `sys_user_position` / `sys_position` (objectui `78b07f468`, objectui#7611);
  - `record:quick_actions`'s `actionNames` description says the empty placeholder shows on a design / preview surface and nothing at runtime (objectui `1d3da6c1e`, objectui#12995).
- `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`: `node scripts/check-sdui-lockstep.mjs` exit 1 before (`[pin-moved]`), `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-4016370af3c9 pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` exit 0, then `pnpm check:sdui-lockstep` exit 0: byte-identical to objectui@4016370af3c9 over 214 grammar lines (blob `0131f27cf86d`), all 25 diagnostic codes, and the `not-a-container` predicate (blob `76c18fb95d1f`). Both blobs are unchanged, so no parser port is owed.
- `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-4016370af3c9 node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, exit 0: present, intact, recorded at the live pin, and `@object-ui 17.7.0` is what the pin declares.

## The console changeset

`.changeset/24457-console-pin-4016370af3c9.md` was written by `scripts/bump-objectui.sh --no-commit` and renamed to this card's prefix, as PR #24311 did. Its list is the generator's, untouched.

- `@objectstack/console` **minor**: 32 releasing changesets across 33 non-merge commits, 1 annotated breaking, 0 release-nothing, and 1 commit without a changeset (`749ed7607`, objectui#12957's tooling merge).
- The generator writes an unanswered ADR-0087 placeholder whenever the range declares a breaking entry, and says a human must answer it (`ADR_0087_SCAFFOLD`, objectstack#6494). It is answered `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` against this tree, with `Clause-②: no` beside it, as in PR #24311:
  - objectui `78b07f468` (objectui#7611) narrows four objectui faces: `@object-ui/core`'s `recordDelete.confirmText`, the `perm.facet.*` / `objectActions.resetPackageSet*` pack keys of `@object-ui/i18n`, the `field:permission-facet-link` registry key of `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, and `objectui check`'s known types in `@object-ui/cli`.
  - No package in this tree imports or depends on an `@object-ui/*` package (`git grep` over sources and manifests: 0). No file in this tree authors `widget: 'permission-facet-link'` (0). The `sys_permission_set` object whose facets that widget drew is no longer served here (ADR-0131 stage 8).

  - The derivation said the tree was 4 commits behind `origin/main` `31ce45c071` and that one gate script changed in that range (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, an artifact-roster family outside the 72). This PR does not merge `main` again for that; the queue rebuilds on the current `main`.
- Named in that list and worth reading out: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` 0 (the exemption notice names this changeset), `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` 0, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` 0, `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` 0 and `--self-test` 0, `pnpm check:sdui-lockstep` 0, `pnpm check:console-sha` 0, `pnpm check:console-injection` 0, `pnpm check:objectui-changeset` 0, `pnpm check:nul-bytes` 0.

## CI

- **The Console Pin Gate does not run on this PR or in the merge queue.** `ci.yml` (THE TWO SPEEDS, lines 93-98) and the `console-pin` job's `if:` exclude `pull_request` and `merge_group`. The fleet-write relay cannot dispatch `ci.yml` either: `WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_ALLOWLIST` in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` holds only `shard-timings-refresh.yml` and `release.yml`. So the **pre-merge full battery is NOT MEASURED**, and the local equivalent above is the pre-merge reading.
- **The CI proof is `main`'s first full-battery run after the merge** (a `push` run, or the hourly `schedule` run if that push run is cancelled first). This PR changes `.objectui-sha`, so the console-dist cache key misses and that run builds the console fresh at `4016370af3c9`. The dispatching seat reads it and links it on #24457; if it is red, it is a `main`-red this card owns.
- The fast set (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard and the rest) runs on this PR as usual.

## Acceptance notes

Observations, not filed:

- `scripts/build-console.sh` (and `bump-objectui.sh`) default to the sibling `../objectui` when `OBJECTUI_ROOT` is unset. In the multi-agent worktree layout that sibling is a shared checkout, and the build adds a git worktree to it and may fetch into it (its working tree and HEAD are not touched). This run named a scratch clone every time. Documented sibling layout, not a defect.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` without `OBJECTUI_ROOT` reads that sibling too (read-only); there it prints NOT CHECKED for the version leg, because the sibling does not carry the pin. With `OBJECTUI_ROOT` named it checks the leg and passes.
- objectui `46dbf32bf57f` was passed over because two of its check-runs ended `cancelled` (its CI was cancelled when the next commit landed), so they never reached a verdict.
- Already raised on #24306's report and not repeated as findings here: the console-dist cache key's coverage of the six non-spec manifests, and `check-console-injection`'s "injected and published spec" wording for a no-skew stamp.
